prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one production pixel-art sprite atlas for an educational garden courtyard in the VOICES top-down 2D game. Generate a single transparent-background atlas with EXACTLY 8 separate assets in a perfectly spaced 4-column by 2-row grid, no labels, no text, no watermarks. Each asset must be wholly contained in its cell with at least 12% empty transparent padding on every side; nothing touches cell edges. Style: warm sophisticated hand-made pixel art, dark clean outlines, readable shapes, muted forest green, cream stone, ochre gold, terracotta, teal; 3/4 front/top-down RPG game perspective, matching a cozy museum with small expressive Black characters. Top row left to right: (1) elegant rectangular framed educational mosaic, celebrating a Black girl with natural curly hair and a Black boy with afro-textured hair, joyful dignified portrait, no caricature; (2) framed mosaic showing Black women and men as respected professionals, teacher scientist artisan, no text; (3) framed mosaic showing open speech bubbles, two equal-valued dark and light ceramic tiles, leaves and hands, no hierarchy or color ranking; (4) framed mosaic showing a confident Black woman with books and flowering plants, celebrating autonomy and dignity, not sexualized. Bottom row left to right: (5) framed mosaic of old books, magnifying glass and archival pages, representing evidence and research; (6) framed mosaic of people listening in a circle and one person offering support, welcoming school setting; (7) freestanding decorative wood garden gateway/pergola with vines, two complete posts and gold-green blank small plaque, open empty passage, no floor; (8) freestanding terracotta-and-green public notice board on complete short legs, blank cream central area, a few colored empty paper cards and small plants around feet. The six framed mosaics should be straight-on rectangles, the last two courtyard objects game perspective. Do not show any insults, words or lettering. Crisp discrete pixel edges, broad pixel clusters rather than glossy food painting or smooth gradients.

Edit target: the attached 8-asset courtyard sprite atlas. Preserve every framed mosaic illustration, frame edge, garden pergola post, vine, flowers, notice board and both complete feet exactly. Keep the 4 by 2 cell layout, object shapes, colors and internal opaque cream areas. Change ONLY the exterior background: remove all the white/gray matte, haze, floor, drop shadows and glow surrounding the eight objects, including inside the open pergola passage, so those exterior regions have fully transparent alpha=0. No background rectangles or checkerboard pattern. Leave a wide transparent margin around every complete silhouette. The inside of all six rectangular framed mosaics and the noticeboard paper must remain opaque. Production transparent PNG game sprite atlas, crisp edges. No text.
